activity_summary: At the lodging you struck the Latin end and wrote the cue so that it finishes on "and that is enough." You shortened the speech before it so the ear meets the word. Under that you pencilled two jokes about a lady of uncommon stature: the oath on a stool, and the hook that gives way first. You wrote that there is one book, not two. You did not recopy the parts. The firing was not restarted.
